blocks.text: More options rise in Mandaue City as Cebu Landmasters Incorporated officially launches the Retail Bloc at Casa Mira Towers Mandaue. Located in Barangay Ibabao, Mandaue City, the newest commercial bloc features commercial spaces, including food establishments, retail shops, and stores offering essentials, bringing comfort and accessibility to residents and nearby communities. MORE for the VisMin region What began a decade ago has grown into an expanding residential brand under Cebu Landmasters Incorporated. To date, Casa Mira has 19 developments and 20,000 units nationwide, living up to the company’s continued commitment to providing accessible housing and creating opportunities for communities across the […]...
